sources.quote: A new coalition of tech giants aims to speed AI data center grid connections
A new coalition that includes Google, Nvidia, Anthropic, and Emerald AI wants to find 100 GW of grid capacity for new data centers.

claims.statement: A coalition of technology companies aims to speed grid connections for AI data centers.

sources.quote: NVIDIA and Google's new coalition wants to speed up AI data center power grid connections
Google, Nvidia, and Anthropic want Emerald AI to find space on the grid for more data centers

claims.statement: The coalition includes Google and Nvidia.

sources.quote: wants to find 100 GW of grid capacity for new data centers

claims.statement: The coalition is targeting 100 GW of grid capacity.
Faster connections are offered in exchange for flexibility.

discrepancies.explanation: One outlet gives a capacity target and names more members; the other names what the coalition offers grid operators in return.

quotes.quote: wants to find 100 GW of grid capacity for new data centers

headline: Tech coalition formed to speed grid connections for AI data centers
summary: Two outlets report a new coalition of technology companies aiming to get AI data centers connected to the electricity grid faster. One gives a target of 100 GW and names more members; the other reports the trade-off being offered to grid operators.
